title: Letter and Will
author: Theo Thornbury
blurb: Elodie Sandoval, a hotel concierge who notices everything, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
